Subject (in full) Communist Meeting held in Chapei.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Some twenty members of the Chapei District Committee
of the local Chinese Communist Party held a meeting in the
Dong Chi (同清) Motor Garage, Tien Tung An Road, Chapei,
between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. July 30, 1931. Shu Tsz Zang
(许子让), member of the Chapei District Committee, presided.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That in view of raids made on important organs of the
Communist Party and the arrest of comrades at the scene
of any proposed demonstrations as a result of the
treachery of the imperialistic Kuomintang, the Examination
Corps of the C.P., which is composed of unemployed workers,
be requested to conduct a thorough investigation into the
activities of such traitors and to resort to assassination
if necessary.
2. That "flying" meetings be held on August 1 to further
propaganda concerning the following:
a) Down with the Imperialistic Kuomintang.
b) Demand the release of arrested workers.
3. That each Branch Office be provided with a myriagraph
duplicator for the printing of propaganda.
4. That reliable messengers (known as "Communication" among
the communists) be detailed to distribute literature
among members and in the event of their being arrested,
they be instructed not to give information to the
Police.

Reg. Ruth
